The helper prepends a fixed comment sequence, `<!-- '"` --><!-- </textarea></xmp> --></option></form>`, before generated form tags, so any unclosed quote, textarea, option, or form the attacker left open is closed before the form's fields begin. The feature is off by default (`prepend_content_exfiltration_prevention = false` in `railtie.rb`), and `form_tag_helper.rb` and `url_helper.rb` call `prevent_content_exfiltration` on their output.

The repo has no dedicated dangling-markup defense. The closest markup is the hidden `<input>` elements Rails emits at the top of generated forms, each with `autocomplete="off"`. That attribute controls browser autofill, not data exfiltration, so it does not stop injected unfinished tags or quotes from leaking form data.
